TC-19/S19.detail: B18 re-check on 8b4be94a: CHANGED. The data-loss symptom is gone: the hold B wrote is stored as changeDate 'Oct 19' (the server's UTC day; the Tokyo day is Oct 20, both accepted), the row's updatedAt is server time, A and B both show 'Held · Oct 19' and the row is still on the chart after both devices opened it (on e02167f it was stamped two days back and the lifecycle deleted it). Still failing (UAT 3.8): the chart's medicationsUpdatedAt is B's device time, 2026-10-17T18:07 vs server 2026-10-19T18:07 (src/features/rounding/patient/useMedicationEventExtraction.ts:103 new Date()); recorded, gated TFA-94699: the resident's visit date stored as B's day 'Sat Oct 17 2026'. medicationsUpdatedAt feeds the held/stopped 36 h clock (convex/lib/lifecycle.ts chartProcessedAt = max(...)), so a fast device would keep held rows longer; a slow one no longer deletes them.
